environment: **Workshop repo**: a training task board (Angular 22 app, Express API in server/), no production data, no deploy targets. Repository visibility: danielsogl/shi-ai-coding-masterclass-exercises on github.com is public. Pushes only with explicit user approval naming the remote.

**Download-only hosts**: registry.npmjs.org (npm ci, declared packages), the Playwright browser CDN (npx playwright install), mcp.context7.com (doc lookups). Trusted for downloads and lookups only; publishing or sending repo content there is still blocked.
**Local services**: localhost and 127.0.0.1 run the dev server and the tests.
soft_deny: Workshop Secrets [named+specifics — **must name:** the file]: Reading, printing, copying, diffing, staging (git add -f), overwriting or sending server/.env or any other .env or .env.* file except .env.example, by any tool or command (cat, grep, node -e, cp, git show). The Standard Credentials exception does not apply to these files. The app loading its own .env at runtime (npm start, the tests) is not this rule.

Workshop Push [named+specifics — **must name:** the remote or target repository]: Any command that sends commits, refs or repo content to a remote: git push (also --mirror, subtree), gh pr create, gh pr merge, gh repo sync, and pushes from scripts. The Git Push Destination exception does not apply in this repo.

Workshop Dependencies [named+specifics — **must name:** the package(s), or the bulk operation for npm update and npm audit fix]: Adding, removing or upgrading npm packages in any package.json of the repo (npm install <pkg>, npm uninstall, npm update, npm audit fix, ng add, ng update, npm exec or npx of a package not declared in package.json, edits to dependencies in package.json or package-lock.json). npx playwright install is not this rule. npm ci or npm install without a package name on an unchanged manifest is not this rule.
